oop_basis_note: The Out-of-Pocket Health Care standard is published PER PERSON per month, not per household. A form that prints one household figure (433-A printed line 42) must multiply this by the household size; a form that prints a per-person rate alongside a headcount (433-F, which carries separate under-65 / 65-over counts) must NOT. This key exists because the amount alone cannot tell a caller which it is, and guessing wrong misprices the whole statement. Note the structural tell: every household-scaled figure in this file is dimensioned by household size (`national`, `national_addl_total`); `oop` is a bare scalar per age band, because the multiplier is the headcount.
